value.title: Anti-step-on: typing gate with idle expiry, self-echo exemption, fresh send-boundary capture
value.complexity_breakdown: CS3: two bounded units against an existing live mechanism; the risk is behavioral (over-hold vs step-on), not structural.
value.confidence: high — TS reference implementation exists with an operator contract test suite; rs baseline verified live in 3 consumption paths.
value.summary: Close the four verified gaps between pij-rs's live InteractionGate and the TS pane-signals reference (plan 058): idle expiry, self-echo exemption, fresh capture at the send boundary, layout-aware composer recognition. PRD req-0004.

sections.name: summary
sections.value: rs already gates injection on human interaction (InteractionGate, fed by PaneObserver, consulted at first-attempt delivery, drain retries, pointer worker). But: a walked-away draft holds a pane FOREVER (no idle expiry — the exact over-hold that forced TS's 2026-07-25 fleet-wide emergency bypass, commit 72b5dd61); pij's own injected bytes can acquire a hold against itself (no self-echo exemption); the verdict is an observer-tick stale read, not a fresh capture at the moment of injection; and the live layout parser (OMP box row, plain-rule pair, copilot footer, caret clip, prompt strip — pane_observer.rs:389-513) is buried in the daemon where the fresh send-boundary path cannot reach it, with 'no region' collapsing into None instead of an explicit Unrecognized verdict. This plan fixes exactly those, nothing else. AMENDED 2026-08-31 at the PM ack: the original wording claimed composer detection was 'a whitespace heuristic, blind to layouts' — false on tree; the fourth gap is an EXTRACTION, not a build.

sections.name: goals
value: A hold self-expires after a bounded idle window (default 60s of unchanged composer content) — a parked draft delays delivery, never blocks it.
pij's own injected payload never acquires a hold and never clears an active human hold.
The injection verdict at the send boundary derives from a capture taken AT the send boundary.

The live composer parser is extracted to pij-harnesses behind one shared signature so the observer tick and the fresh send-boundary path use ONE parser; 'no region' becomes an explicit Unrecognized that defers.
Every veto is bounded: deferral is conservative, never permanent — the over-hold cannot re-enter through the unrecognizability door (amendment 2, PM escalation 2026-08-31).

sections.name: non_goals
value: No busy-density signal (TS has it, UI-only, never gated delivery — out of scope).
No caret/byte-stream fallback tracker port (rs's tap-active veto already covers the unrecognised-layout case conservatively).
No change to paneless/pull-consumer behaviour (never gated — pinned by regression test, not rebuilt).
No new env tunables beyond one daemon-config field for the idle window; constants otherwise mirror TS (pane-signals.ts:3-7).
NOT a rewrite of InteractionGate consumers — the three call sites keep their shape.

value.claim: Parked draft: composer non-blank and UNCHANGED for longer than the idle window → delivery proceeds (hold expired).
Active typing: composer content changed within the idle window → delivery held and queued durably; nothing injected.
Self-echo: a payload recorded via record_self_injection never acquires a hold when it appears in the composer, and an ACTIVE human hold is never cleared by any echo.
Fresh boundary: with a stale-clear observer state and a human typing NOW, the send path holds — the verdict came from a capture at send time.

Layout parsing EXTRACTED to pij-harnesses with behaviour pinned: characterisation tests over live-recorded captures prove the extracted parser byte-equal to the pre-move rendered_composer on every fixture, plus the one NEW behaviour red-first: an unrecognised layout yields an explicit Unrecognized verdict that DEFERS (was a silent None). Labeled honestly: pin + one witness, not a greenfield build.
Paneless seat is never gated (existing behaviour pinned by a regression test that survives this change).

NO UNBOUNDED VETO: with no interaction observation (content change, tap byte, or mode flag) younger than the idle window, ANY veto — recognized-idle, Unrecognized, or tap-latched — decays within interaction_idle_ms to the tmux pane_in_mode verdict alone. Witnessed red-first: on the pre-amendment tree an Unrecognized pane is vetoed forever.

sections.name: risks_assumptions
sections.value: RISK 1 — over-hold regression: the TS gate was emergency-bypassed fleet-wide (72b5dd61) because holds outlived their cause; idle expiry is the mitigation and ac-1 is its witness — the witness must be proven RED on the pre-fix tree first (a green-from-birth regression test is a claim, not a witness). RISK 2 — self-echo certification too loose: certifying by resemblance instead of progress lets a human's paste of similar text be eaten; mirror TS's progress rule. RISK 3 — fresh capture cost: one extra capture-pane per send is acceptable; per-tick captures already happen. ASSUMPTION — TmuxPort can serve a composer capture at send time (PaneObserver already captures; if the port needs a new method, that is part of u-observer's fence). RISK 5 (found by PM at wave 1, inherited not introduced, but ENTRENCHED if unfixed since the fresh verdict becomes the authorising one): Unrecognized had no expiry path, and live Copilot v1.0.82 renders no prompt marker so an entire harness class parses Unrecognized in BOTH the TS and Rust parsers — an unbounded hold shipped inside the anti-over-hold plan. Retired by ac-1117 (universal veto bound) + Copilot recognition rebuilt from a live v1.0.82 fixture.

value.question: Should the idle window be per-harness (copilot's slower composer) or one global default?
value.note: Start global 60s like TS; split only on observed need.
